note: v4, 2:44–2:59: the inner pair sustains the previous riff’s last note with B-flat. Three fast kicks or two broad ones count the band back in halfway through the new phrase.
The intro toms teach the clipped guitar rhythm in two groups of three. Both amps know it before bass and kick land at 0:10.
v8, 2:22–2:31: the high guitar arrives one, three and seven sixteenths before the unchanged bass and facing guitar. The releases stay put. The quick riff catches the last C up to Db.
v10, 0:30–0:40: one guitar trades the two answers an octave up, then plays the riff from its half cell; the other side takes it next. The cell with C is in unison again before the organ.

v14, 2:45–2:50: the swing's two-cell quick phrase is the opening groove again (first riff, two guitars, bass, closed hat on the six steps); the wall pair rests after its held notes. The only return of that groove after 1:00.
v18: the broad walk at double speed for two cells (1:15-1:20), eight steps a cell, then v13's half speed; the organ's sigh doubles there too
v20: 2:30-2:40, the kettle comes back with the heavy riff and keeps the broad footfalls while the drummer walks six, then twelve (the step both walks share) into the broad walk at 2:40
